content.title: When do McDonald's 'KPop Demon Hunters' meals come out?
content.text: March 30, 2026, 4:32 p.m. ETMcDonald's is giving "KPop Demon Hunters" fans a K-pop battle for the ages, with its first-ever dueling adult Happy Meals featuring Netflix animated icons HUNTR/X vs Saja Boys duking it out for McDonald's "Battle of the Fans." And Huntrix fans say it's gonna be "Golden."The limited-edition McDonald's "KPop Demon Hunters" meals drop Tuesday, March 31, 2026, featuring two new Happy Meals: The Huntr/X Meal, featuring the girls who make up the fictional K-pop group HUNTR/X — Rumi, Mira and Zoey — and a Saha Boys meal for you McDonald's breakfast run.The new McDonald's adult Happy Meals don't come with Happy Meal toys — like the new McDonald's "Super Mario Galaxy" Happy Meal — but features collectible HUNTR/X and Saja Boys Photocards. The McDonald's Huntrix meal offers fans spicy Ramyeon McShaker fries and purple "Demon Sauce. A big fan of Derpy Tiger? The Derpy McFlurry is also available.Here's what to know about the new "KPop Demons Hunters" Happy Meal and how to get it in NJ.When does McDonald's 'KPop Demon Hunters' meal come out?McDonald's new "KPop Demon Hunters" Happy Meal comes out on Tuesday, March 31, 2026. The new adult Happy Meal at McDonald's will be available nationwide at participating restaurants for a limited time.What's in 'KPop Demon Hunters' adult Happy Meals?The McDonald's "KPop Demon Hunters" meals include the HUNTR/X Meal and the Saja Boys meal, which is part of McDonald's breakfast menu.The "Huntrix" meal, or Huntr/X adult Happy Meal, features 10-piece McDonald's Chicken McNuggets, medium soft drink and Ramyeon McShaker Fries, with a spicy, umami spin featuring soy, garlic, sesame and spice seasoning. The fries are inspired by Rumi, Zoey and Mira's go-to noodle snack. You'll sprinkle the seasoning into a McShaker bag, throw in the fries and shake away. Demon Sauce (purple-colored mustard) and Hunter Sauce (sweet chili mix) are available.The Saja Boys Breakfast Meal features a Sausage McMuffin with Egg, topped with a peppery Spicy Saja Sauce. You also get hash browns and a small soft drink (a little "Soda Pop" to cool down, of course)McDonald's Happy Meal toysMcDonald's new "KPop Demon Hunters" adult Happy Meals do not feature toys, like the current McDonald's Happy Meal toys in the "Super Mario Galaxy" meal but will include collectible Photocard packs consisting of an exclusive photocard for either HUNTR/X or the Saja Boys and an exclusive Derpy access card.The Derpy card — inspired by the Hunters' lovable Derpy Tiger — provides a unique QR code to scan on the McDonald's App. Fans must scan the code by April 26 to unlock first access to exclusive "KPop Demon Hunter" content and see who wins the "Battle for the Fans" between HUNTR/X and the Saja Boys.What's in the Derpy McFlurry?McDonald's "Derpy McFlurry" includes a creamy vanilla soft serve with blackberry popping pearls, all mixed in a wild berry sauce. The new "KPop Demon Hunters" McFlurry at McDonald's is inspired by fan-favorite Derpy Tiger from the popular animated film.How much does McDonald's 'Huntrix' Happy Meal cost?The cost of the "KPop Demon Hunters" adult Happy meal varies by location. When previous McDonald's Happy Meals for adults dropped, such as "The Grinch," and "Mcdonaldland," the price was between $15 and $17 across McDonald's in New Jersey. When the meal drops, check the McDonald's app, find your location to check how much it'll cost.The "Super Mario Galaxy" Happy Meal for kids averages $6 to $7 in New Jersey but varies by location.How to find a McDonald's near me in NJIs there a McDonald's near me? It's likely since there are over 250 McDonald's locations in New Jersey. To find a McDonald's near you and to grab the new HUNTER/X and Saja Boys meal in New Jersey, visit McDonald's online locator.Lori Comstock is a New Jersey-based news reporter covering trending news with USA TODAY Network's Mid-Atlantic Connect Team. She covers news in the Northeast, including New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Delaware, Washington DC, Maryland, and Virginia. Reach her at LComstock@usatodayco.com.
